module sessions.store.scenarios
use sessions.store

scenario "a tick removes only sessions idle for more than an hour" {
  given clock = FakeClock.new()
  given _ = touch("old")
  given _ = clock.advance(50m)
  given _ = touch("fresh")
  given _ = clock.advance(20m)
  when  r = tick(Sweeper)
  then  r == Ok(())
  then  Sessions.get("old") == Ok(None)
  then  Sessions.get("fresh").map(fn(s) => s.is_some()) == Ok(true)
}

scenario "advancing the clock alone never fires a tick" {
  given clock = FakeClock.new()
  given _ = touch("old")
  when  _ = clock.advance(2h)
  then  Sessions.get("old").map(fn(s) => s.is_some()) == Ok(true)
}
